__doc__: Quest objectives that are legitimately open at the same time. The runtime sweep in the generated stage fragments closes any earlier objective the player has seen and moved past; these are exempt because the player can finish them in any order, so an earlier one is still a live task when a later one is displayed. Keyed EditorID -> [objective stage indices]. A quest absent here is swept normally; a miss leaves an objective open, which is the pre-existing behaviour.
